beat: Monday tuition: Bantu arrives alone and negotiates video classes

lines.original: Monday she did not happen to see the twins at college.... but she guessed they might be coming for tuition soon and she was getting refreshed so that she can be ready when they come... Pappu was sleeping in her bedroom....
lines.local: Monday ko Dhika ko college mein twins nahi dikhe. Use laga woh tuition ke liye jaldi aayenge, isliye ready hone ko fresh ho rahi thi; Pappu bedroom mein so raha tha.

lines.original: Today she wore a normal knee length T shirt and a dark coloured half hand T shirt.... Thankfully it was not a hand day today... it was pleasant....
lines.local: RAW is line mein 'normal knee length T shirt' aur 'dark coloured half hand T shirt' dono kehta hai. In dono ko wahi ambiguous garment wording ke saath preserve kiya ja raha hai; exact knee-length garment category source se confirm nahi. Mausam pleasant tha, aaj garmi nahi thi.

lines.original: Ding Dong......
lines.local: Ding Dong!

lines.original: Dhika: That must be the twins.....she peeped into the peep hole and saw only Bantu standing outside..... she opened the door...
lines.local: Dhika ko laga twins aaye honge. Peephole se dekha toh sirf Bantu tha; usne door khola.

lines.original: Bantu: Hi beautilful miss... he gave her a smile and moved inside the house..
lines.local: Bantu muskuraakar: Hi beautiful miss! Kehte hue ghar ke andar aa gaya.

lines.original: Dhika: Hey dear.... you alone? where is Bobby... both moved into the sofa...
lines.local: Dhika: Hey dear, akele? Bobby kahan hai? Dono sofa par baithe.

lines.original: Bantu: We are leaving to home town for a function now miss and he is packing miss... I too didn't come for class.. I just came to inform you....
lines.local: Bantu: Miss, hum hometown mein function ke liye ja rahe hain; Bobby packing kar raha hai. Main bhi class ke liye nahi aaya, bas aapko batane aaya hoon.

lines.original: Dhika: smiling... oh, so no class for a week?
lines.local: Dhika muskuraakar: Achha, toh ek hafte tak class nahi?

lines.original: Bantu: hmm... thats what I wanted to talk miss...
lines.local: Bantu: Hmm, wahi toh baat karni thi miss.

lines.original: Dhika: oh... what dear ?
lines.local: Dhika: Oh, kya dear?

lines.original: Bantu: Miss... till we come back, can you please give us session online... its really important since the competition is nearing.... I definitely want to see Switzerland.... hehe
lines.local: Bantu: Miss, wapas aane tak please online sessions de sakti hain? Competition paas hai; mujhe Switzerland zaroor dekhna hai, hehe!

lines.original: Dhika: hehe... I am sure you want to...... yeah no problem... I can do online session in same time... I even have a web cam... we can see each other.... she offered video call herself...
lines.local: Dhika: Hehe, haan bilkul! Same time online session le sakti hoon. Mere paas webcam bhi hai, hum ek-doosre ko dekh sakte hain. Video call Dhika ne khud offer ki.

lines.original: Bantu was nibbling on the thought of how to make her come into video call... it wasn't really necessary.. they just needed a screen share and notepad...
lines.local: Bantu soch raha tha ki Dhika ko video call par kaise laaye; asal mein zaroorat nahi thi—screen share aur notepad kaafi the.

lines.original: Bantu: That sounds awesome miss...... thank you... We can start from Wednesday....
lines.local: Bantu: Bahut badiya miss, thank you! Wednesday se start karte hain.

lines.original: Dhika: You could have just called me right... why did you come all the way here to tell this... hehe
lines.local: Dhika: Sirf phone kar dete na; itni door khud aane ki kya zaroorat thi? Hehe.

lines.original: Bantu: ohhhhh..... I wanted to see you.....he put on a sad face....
lines.local: Bantu ne udaas chehra banaya: Ohhh… main toh aapko dekhna chahta tha.

lines.original: Dhika: hehe..... you came and saw right... why sad face then....
lines.local: Dhika: Hehe, ab dekh liya na; phir udaas kyun?

lines.original: Bantu: because you are not even in a sexy dress today...... he pouted his lower lips and looked like a puppy....
lines.local: Bantu lower lip pout karke puppy jaise: Kyunki aaj aapne sexy dress hi nahi pehni.

lines.original: Dhika: hehe.. why, am not looking pretty in this....
lines.local: Dhika: Hehe, kya main is outfit mein pretty nahi lag rahi?

lines.original: Bantu: eh... you are..... but you have worn a half hand T shirt... he dragged the words...
lines.local: Bantu: Lag toh rahi hain… lekin aapne half-sleeve T-shirt pehni hai… usne shabdon ko kheenchkar kaha.
